Description
As one of the world’s purest
gold bullion coins
, Canadian Maple Leaf Coin is characterized by its beautiful design and innovative minting methods. This immaculate Canadian 1/10 oz Gold Maple Leaf coin keeps the renowned
Royal Canadian Mint’s
high standard of production with safety features that contribute to a superior, personalized design. Imitating the real appearance of the real maple leaf, this Canadian coinage has been authorized by the Canadian Government and the
Canadian Numismatic Association.
When it comes to the amount of gold that is in each coin, they hold a tenth of an ounce of gold in them and come in .9999 pure gold. These coins are rather plentiful since they were minted so recently, which means that they can be bought in large quantities. Also, since there is not a great deal of gold in these coins, they are a wise investment option for people who are new to buying gold, allowing them to accumulate a decent amount of money over time.
The Royal Canadian Mint is responsible for the production of the Canadian Gold Maple Leaf, which is Canada’s official bullion coin. The 1/10 oz Gold Maple Leaf, a pure gold coin of regular issue that has a gold content of 1/10 troy oz of .9999 (24 Karats), is among the finest. Some special issues are.99999. It is composed of only Canadian gold, which means it has virtually no base metals. This 1/10 oz gold coin bears a face value of 5 Canadian dollars but the gold value is more. The purity and the weight of this gold coin are backed by the Canadian Government.
Design of Canadian 1/10 oz Gold Maple Leaf Coin
An effigy featuring Queen Elizabeth II can be found on the obverse all 1/10oz Canadian Gold Maple Leaf Coins. Depending on the year of issue, the portrait of Queen Elizabeth 2 in the right-profile position may differ. From 1979 until 1989, the design was dominated by a portrait from Arnold Machin. It was replaced between 1990 and 2003 by Dora de Pedery Huts depiction. Today, coins made after 2004 feature Susanna Blints design.
The reverse side of 1/10 oz Canadian Maple Leaf Gold Coins will display the image of a single, large, and extremely detailed sugar maple leaf. This illustration of the sugar maple Leaf captures the natural lines and striations of the maple leaves. It is flanked on both sides by the inscriptions Canada, Fine Gold 1/10 oz Or Pur. Walter Ott designed the design for the first series in 1979.
Main Highlights of 1/10 ounce Canadian Gold Maple Leaf Coin
Contains 1/10 troy oz of .9999 pure gold.
Manufactured by the Royal Canadian Mint.
Each Gold coin comes in protective packaging.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
Bears a face value of 5 Canadian Dollars.
Features the depiction of her Majesty, Queen Elizabeth II on the obverse.
Features the depiction of a single, large Maple Leaf.
